## Current-main lane

This is the sole current-main continuation for the Alpha portability work previously carried as stacked PRs #19, #21, and #22. Closing those transport branches must not discard the contracts below.

Creation baseline:

- Foresight main: `2013351996f1766246f201640795f342b3e12461`
- Katamorph gitlink: `3bd4cf26e68dc88fbe67f831baa4bc389e3363e7`

Implementation must start from then-current `main`; do not merge an old feature-stack base or pin an invisible integration commit.

## Immutable source evidence

- #19 `2781b9e386b60eb7415087aa54a8c46a9fcfe558` — recursive portable semantic payload maps
- #21 `d2072438cfc938e727a92b46e983ac9e00a8a15e` — safe cross-runtime integer identities and `:alpha/id`
- #22 `995c91b050e27f9a3bbb8abb61293fba37857eb6` — portable envelopes for open/extensible records
- Upstream ownership candidate: open-hax/katamorph#18 at `a8be789605f8e4266398bdfbadf06def22e72be4`

These source heads had no PR-triggered workflow run and no review threads. #22 also trails the current #21 head, so ancestor status cannot serve as merge evidence.

## Semantics to preserve

- One recursive keyword/string-keyed `PortableMap` authority derived from Katamorph portable values.
- Portable legacy/lossless frontmatter, Artifact/Event payloads, and operation configuration/input maps.
- Nested functions and host objects fail on both runtimes.
- Alpha IDs admit keyword, string, UUID, or integers within ±(2^53−1); doubles and unsafe integers fail.
- `:alpha/id` remains registered.
- Open project-extension fields remain allowed only when recursively portable.
- Untyped `:document/structure` remains shape-open but portability-bounded.
- This lane owns the portability envelope consumed by Event, Markdown, Diagram artifacts, and Reaction inputs; downstream lanes must not fork it.

## Dependency boundary

Current Katamorph exposes `PortableValue` and `PortableNumber` but not the named `PortableInteger` used by the old stack. Resolve ownership in a merged Katamorph revision (prefer the reviewed outcome of open-hax/katamorph#18) or explicitly reuse the merged number kernel without copying its grammar into Alpha.

## Acceptance / Definition of Done

- [ ] Fresh current-main PR records its exact Foresight base SHA and exact Katamorph gitlink SHA.
- [ ] One registered CLJC suite executes the same assertions under JVM Clojure and Node ClojureScript.
- [ ] Boundary tests cover safe-integer extrema and adjacent failures, doubles, JVM functions/objects, CLJS functions/JS objects, nested payloads, extension fields, and existing lawful specimens.
- [ ] A two-reader lexical smoke proves canonical keys/fixture IDs read on both JVM and CLJS; slash-qualified keyword names are prohibited.
- [ ] All current Alpha JVM and CLJS laws pass at the replacement head; neither result may be inherited from an ancestor.
- [ ] No unmerged/invisible Katamorph revision is pinned.
- [ ] Receipt River records observation, ownership decision, test-run, and pushed exact-head truth; Session Mycology records reusable cross-runtime friction.
- [ ] Source PRs #19, #21, and #22 remain linked as immutable provenance.

## Exit

Close this issue only when the consolidated current-main PR is merged with revision-bound JVM+CLJS evidence, or when a named immutable upstream blocker is recorded with a bounded follow-up.
